description: This file defines the BrowseViewModel class for managing recipe data and UI state in the browsing screen of an Android TV application. It handles data loading, filtering by cuisine or favorites, and toggling favorite status, using Kotlin coroutines and flows.

classes.name: BrowseViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing recipe data, filter states, and user interactions for the browsing screen.

classes.name: BrowseUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different UI states during recipe data loading.

classes.name: FilterType
classes.description: Sealed class defining filtering options for recipe browsing.

methods.name: loadRecipes
methods.description: Loads recipes based on the current selected filter, updating UI state accordingly.

methods.name: loadCuisines
methods.description: Fetches the list of available cuisines from the repository.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Sets a new filter and reloads recipes accordingly.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID.
